types.name: ABaseSound

fields.name: vtable
fields.comment: high: ctor 1bfa0 stores vtable 0x18a510 (4 slots); ~ABaseSound 11c6f0 restores it. PS2 vptr is LAST (+0xac, ctor 2fcdb0 / dtor 2fcb28); MSVC puts it first and pads to 0x10 because the class is 16-byte aligned

fields.name: position
fields.comment: high: ctor zeroes +0x10/14/18; AVehicle::Play 11f9b0 takes its address. PS2 +0x0 SetPosition/SetPV/IsPlaying (Xbox = PS2+0x10). Vectors sit on a 16-byte stride (pad dword +0x1c never written)

fields.name: velocity
fields.comment: high: ctor zeroes +0x20..0x28; AVehicle CalculateSpeed 11eb50/Play take its address. PS2 +0x10 Get/SetVelocity, SetPV

fields.name: forward
fields.comment: high: ctor sets (0,0,1): +0x30/34=0, +0x38=1.0. PS2 +0x20 Get/SetForward, SetOrientation

fields.name: right
fields.comment: high: ctor +0x40/44=0, +0x48=1.0. PS2 +0x30 Get/SetRight, SetOrientation

fields.name: up
fields.comment: high: ctor +0x50/54=0, +0x58=1.0. PS2 +0x40 Get/SetUp, SetOrientation

fields.name: cameraAim
fields.comment: medium: not touched by the Xbox ctor (accessors inlined on Xbox); PS2 +0x50 Get/SetCameraAim (not in the PS2 ctor either), +0x10 shift like the other vectors

fields.name: minDistance
fields.comment: high: ctor = 3.0; PS2 +0x5c Get/SetMinDistance

fields.name: maxDistance
fields.comment: high: ctor = 350.0; PS2 +0x60 Get/SetMaxDistance

fields.name: maxDistanceSq
fields.comment: high: ctor = 122500.0 (350^2); PS2 +0x64 GetMaxDistanceSq, written by SetMaxDistance

fields.name: falloff
fields.comment: high: ctor = 0; PS2 +0x68 Get/SetFalloff

fields.name: volume
fields.comment: high: ctor = 1.0; PS2 +0x6c Get/SetVolume

fields.name: pitch
fields.comment: high: ctor = 1.0; PS2 +0x70 Get/SetPitch

fields.name: unk84
fields.comment: low: ctor sets +0x84/88/8c = 1.0 (a scale triple?). PS2 +0x74/78 unseen, +0x7c addr-taken in ctor 2fcdb0. Name invented

fields.name: unk90
fields.comment: low: ctor writes byte 0; PS2 +0x80 4-byte write in ctor (bool shrink). Name invented

fields.name: mix
fields.comment: high: ctor stores AMix::Add(name) result; ~ABaseSound reads it. PS2 +0x84 GetMix/SetMix/GetVolume, -> AMix::Add

fields.name: viewSet
fields.comment: high: ctor: 0 then |= (view==4 ? global 0x243940 : 1<<view); PS2 +0x88 GetViewSet

fields.name: name
fields.comment: medium: GetName 11c710 returns this+0x9c (PS2 GetName +0x8c); length from the gap to +0xac

fields.name: fade
fields.comment: high: GetFade 11c750 computes fadeStep/fadeSteps into +0xac and returns it; StartFade zeroes it. PS2 +0x9c

fields.name: fadeStep
fields.comment: high: StartFade 11c720 zeroes, GetFade increments and compares with +0xb4. PS2 +0xa0. Name invented

fields.name: fadeSteps
fields.comment: high: StartFade(int) stores its argument; GetFade divisor. PS2 +0xa4. Name invented

fields.name: fading
fields.comment: high: StartFade sets 1, GetFade clears when done; PS2 +0xa8 IsFading (4 bytes on PS2)

types.comment: Audio base class (ABaseSound(char *name, AView view)). 16-byte aligned: Xbox vptr padded to 0x10, every PS2 field +0x10 on Xbox; PS2 size 0xb0 with vptr last at +0xac. Size from deleting dtor 1c090 (0xc0).

types.name: ASceneObj

fields.name: flagC0
fields.comment: low: ctor 12e190 zeroes bytes +0xc0..0xc5 and sets +0xc5=1; AVehicle::Play 11f9b0 reads +0xc0..0xc3. PS2 AVehicle::Play reads ints +0xb0..0xbc (bools 4 bytes on PS2). Name invented

fields.name: flagC1
fields.comment: low: as flagC0 (PS2 +0xb4). Name invented

fields.name: flagC2
fields.comment: low: as flagC0 (PS2 +0xb8). Name invented

fields.name: flagC3
fields.comment: low: as flagC0 (PS2 +0xbc). Name invented

fields.name: flagC4
fields.comment: low: ctor 12e190 writes 0. Name invented

fields.name: flagC5
fields.comment: low: ctor 12e190 writes 1. Name invented

types.comment: Positional sound object. Ctor 12e190 = ABaseSound(name, view 4) + six bytes +0xc0..0xc5. Size 0xd0 from AVehicle's first own field (+0xd0 vehicleType, same on PS2 where six 4-byte bools end at 0xc8, padded to 0xd0).

types.name: AStream

fields.name: priv
fields.comment: high: AStreamPriv*: ctor new(0x128)+ctor 0x122190; every accessor (IsOver, GetFile, GetInternalVolume, GetLatency, Stop...) forwards to it. PS2 +0xb0 (-> AStreamPriv::~AStreamPriv)

fields.name: timerFreq10
fields.comment: low: ctor = TIMER_getfrequency()*10. PS2 own fields +0xb4/0xb8/0xbc (Play, QueryTime); exact mapping unproved. Name invented

fields.name: unkC8
fields.comment: low: ctor zeroes. Name invented

fields.name: unkCC
fields.comment: low: ctor zeroes. Name invented

types.comment: Streamed sound; Xbox keeps almost all state in AStreamPriv (+0xc0). PS2's many ctor writes are the inlined ABaseSound ctor; only PS2 +0xb0..0xbc are AStream's own, mapping to Xbox +0xc0..0xcc. Size from alloc/deleting dtor 0xd0.

types.name: AMix

fields.name: master
fields.comment: medium: ClearMaster/SetMaster write it; GetVolume recurses through it (-> AMix::GetVolume). PS2 +0x0 same. Name invented

fields.name: volume
fields.comment: medium: Add 11d6a0 zeroes; GetVolume/Revert/SetTransition. PS2 +0x4. Name invented

fields.name: targetVolume
fields.comment: low: Add zeroes; Revert/SetTransition write. PS2 +0x8. Name invented

fields.name: unkC
fields.comment: low: Add sets -1.0; PS2 ctor +0xc. Name invented

fields.name: presetVolume
fields.comment: medium: Add sets -1.0; GetPresetVolume 11ca90 touches it; PS2 +0x10 GetPresetVolume

fields.name: transitionStart
fields.comment: low: GetVolume/Revert/SetTransition(float,int); PS2 +0x14. Name invented

fields.name: transitionStep
fields.comment: low: as +0x14; PS2 +0x18. Name invented

fields.name: inTransition
fields.comment: medium: byte on Xbox (Add, GetVolume, Revert, SetTransition); PS2 +0x1c 4-byte. Name invented

fields.name: unk24
fields.comment: low: Add zeroes; PS2 ctor +0x24. Name invented

fields.name: unk28
fields.comment: low: Add zeroes; PS2 ctor +0x28. Name invented

fields.name: unk2c
fields.comment: low: Add sets 1.0; PS2 ctor +0x2c float. Name invented

types.comment: Named mix group, allocated 0x50 and initialised inline by AMix::Add 11d6a0, kept in a name index (0x11d610 list, 0x125270 lookup). No vptr; PS2 offsets identical except bool +0x1c. +0x30..0x4f unseen.

types.name: ABank

fields.name: data
fields.comment: high: ctors set 0; bank file loaded via 0x1176d0 then decoded buffer stored; ~ABank frees (MEM_free/UMemory::Free). PS2 +0x0. Name invented

fields.name: unk4
fields.comment: low: ctors set -1; Remove reads. PS2 +0x4 ctor. Name invented

fields.name: handle
fields.comment: medium: ctors set -1; ctor passes &this+0x8 to 0x13cef0 (bank open, out-param); IsPatchPresent 125ec0 passes it to 0x13cf20. PS2 +0x8 addr-taken. Name invented

fields.name: status
fields.comment: high: ctor stores the open result (7 = ok) or -0x13 when the file fails to load; PS2 +0xc Status() const

fields.name: index
fields.comment: high: ctors construct AIndex at +0x10 (0x1279e0 / 0x1276c0 with path+name); ~ABank -> AIndex::~AIndex. Size = 24 - 0x10

types.comment: Sound bank (allocated 24). No vptr, same offsets on PS2.

types.name: AVehicle

fields.name: vehicleType
fields.comment: high: AVehicle::Play 11f9b0 reads +0xd0; PS2 +0xd0 Get/SetVehicleType (AVehicle::VehicleType enum). Same offset on both builds

fields.name: surfaces
fields.comment: high: ctor loop writes 1 to +0xd4..0xe0; Play/PlayCollision/PlayLanding read them. PS2 +0xd4 SetSurface(int,SurfaceType)/GetSurface/IsInAir (ASceneObj::SurfaceType)

fields.name: wheelOnGround
fields.comment: medium: ctor loop writes 1 to +0xe4..0xf0; GetAirborneWheels 11ebf0 counts zero entries of +0xe4[4]; PlayLanding takes its address. PS2 +0xe4 addr-taken in ctor. Name invented

fields.name: compression
fields.comment: medium: no Xbox access seen (accessors inlined/dropped); PS2 +0xf4 Get/SetCompression(float*), and the fields either side have identical offsets on both builds

fields.name: frontSlipTarget
fields.comment: medium: Reset/Play write; PS2 +0x104 SetFrontSlip writes it (GetFrontSlip reads +0x10c). Name invented

fields.name: backSlipTarget
fields.comment: medium: Reset/Play; PS2 +0x108 SetBackSlip. Name invented

fields.name: frontSlip
fields.comment: high: Reset/Play; PS2 +0x10c GetFrontSlip

fields.name: backSlip
fields.comment: high: Reset/Play; PS2 +0x110 GetBackSlip

fields.name: skidMultiple
fields.comment: high: ctor 11e2e0 = 1.0; PS2 +0x114 Get/SetSkidMultiple, ctor

fields.name: gas
fields.comment: high: Reset writes; PS2 +0x118 Get/SetGas

fields.name: rpm
fields.comment: high: CalculateRpm/Reset; PS2 +0x11c Get/SetRpm

fields.name: rpmBase
fields.comment: medium: CalculateRpm 11ec80 adds +0x120 into the result; Play/Reset. PS2 +0x120 CalculateRpm/GetRpm. Name invented

fields.name: unk124
fields.comment: low: floats +0x124..0x138 written by Reset and Play on both builds; roles unknown. Name invented

fields.name: speed
fields.comment: high: CalculateSpeed 11eb50 writes, CalculateRpm reads (log curve); PS2 +0x13c GetSpeed

fields.name: carSpeed
fields.comment: high: no Xbox access seen; PS2 +0x140 Get/SetCarSpeed

fields.name: unk144
fields.comment: low: Reset/Play write floats +0x144/148/14c on both builds. Name invented

fields.name: landingForce
fields.comment: high: PlayLanding writes; PS2 +0x150 Get/SetLandingForce

fields.name: hornHonk
fields.comment: medium: Reset/Play byte; PS2 +0x154 (4-byte bool) HonkHorn. Xbox bools pack: PS2 +0x154..0x168 -> Xbox +0x154..0x159

fields.name: flag155
fields.comment: low: Reset/Play; PS2 +0x158. Name invented

fields.name: flag156
fields.comment: low: Reset/Play; PS2 +0x15c. Name invented

fields.name: boost
fields.comment: medium: Reset writes; PS2 +0x160 SetBoost/Reset

fields.name: ignition
fields.comment: medium: Reset writes; PS2 +0x164 Get/SetIgnition

fields.name: altVoiceSet
fields.comment: low: ctor writes 0, then 1 on one branch that creates a different voice at +0x1a4; PS2 +0x168 ctor. Name invented

fields.name: patchIds
fields.comment: medium: ctor fills +0x15c..0x168 with AIndex lookups (0x126d40) on bank +0x194; Play reads. PS2 +0x16c..0x178 (-0x10 after the bool packing). Name invented

fields.name: unk16c
fields.comment: low: Play/PlayCollision/Reset; PS2 +0x17c..0x184. Name invented

fields.name: terrain
fields.comment: high: ctor/Reset word write; PS2 +0x188 w2 Get/SetTerrain(short)

fields.name: gasButton
fields.comment: low: no Xbox access; PS2 +0x18c Get/SetGasButton; placed by packing four PS2 bools after terrain so the steering floats land at +0x180/0x184 and gun at +0x188 (matches Xbox)

fields.name: brakeButton
fields.comment: low: as gasButton; PS2 +0x190

fields.name: xyTrigger
fields.comment: low: as gasButton; PS2 +0x194

fields.name: xyReleaseTrigger
fields.comment: low: as gasButton; PS2 +0x198

fields.name: steeringPadX
fields.comment: low: no Xbox access; PS2 +0x19c GetSteeringPadX/SetSteering

fields.name: steeringPadY
fields.comment: low: no Xbox access; PS2 +0x1a0 GetSteeringPadY/SetSteering

fields.name: gun
fields.comment: high: AGun*: ctor zeroes, ActivateGun sets, dtor -> AGun::~AGun. PS2 +0x1a4 GetGun

fields.name: turret
fields.comment: high: ATurret*: ActivateTurret, dtor -> ATurret::~ATurret. PS2 +0x1a8 GetTurret

fields.name: zoomer
fields.comment: high: AZoomObj*: ActivateZoom, dtor -> AZoomObj::~AZoomObj. PS2 +0x1ac GetZoomer

fields.name: bank
fields.comment: medium: ctor copies global 0x1d839c; used for AIndex lookups (0x126d40) that fill patchIds; PlayCollision reads. PS2 +0x1b0 -> AIndex::Lookup. Name invented

fields.name: voices
fields.comment: high: 14 AVoice* (operator new 0x58 + ctor 0x123ca0 with a mix from +0x1e4/1e8/1ec) stored at +0x198..0x1cc; Play -> AVoice::Play; dtor frees. PS2 +0x1b4..0x1e8 (14 slots)

fields.name: unk1d0
fields.comment: low: ctor zeroes; dtor -> FUN_0011ec10. PS2 +0x1ec. Name invented

fields.name: carAlarm
fields.comment: medium: ACarAlarm*: ctor zeroes, Play/dtor. PS2 +0x1f0 -> ACarAlarm::Play, StartAlarm

fields.name: wind
fields.comment: high: AVehicleWind*: ActivateWind, dtor -> AVehicleWind::~AVehicleWind. PS2 +0x1f4 GetWind

fields.name: horn
fields.comment: medium: AHorn*: ChooseHorn, CalculateRpm/CalculateSpeed test it. PS2 +0x1f8 -> AHorn::Play

fields.name: asphaltMix
fields.comment: high: ctor = AMix::Get(name); PS2 +0x1fc GetAsphaltMix

fields.name: offRoadMix
fields.comment: high: ctor = AMix::Get; voices created with it; Play -> AMix::GetVolume. PS2 +0x200 GetOffRoadMix

fields.name: mix1e8
fields.comment: medium: ctor = AMix::Get; mix of most voices; Play -> AMix::GetVolume. PS2 +0x204. Name invented

fields.name: mix1ec
fields.comment: medium: ctor = AMix::Get; mix of voices +0x1c4..0x1cc; PS2 +0x208. Name invented

types.comment: Vehicle engine/skid/voice sounds. Fields +0xd0..0x150 have identical offsets on both builds; bool packing at +0x154 (6 PS2 ints -> 6 bytes) shifts everything after by -0x10, then 4 more bools after terrain by a further -0xc (total -0x1c from +0x188). Size from deleting dtor 120d50; PS2 0x20c.
